scope: Train-only coverage ablation. Compare the existing matched held-offset collection with the same collection plus six timed pairs. Both arms share training normalization arrays and optimizer setup. This plan freezes a later fit; the current round performs only offline data and setup checks.
normalization: Use retained_training_v2 arrays from the held-offset control training split in both arms. Before fitting, reproduce them exactly from held-offset training and match the pinned control checkpoint. Timed pairs and held data do not participate in these statistics.
initialization: Fresh identical zero-output ResidualMLP using the pinned seed and physical gains. Use identical S2 anchor windows, horizon cycle, RNG seed and minibatch draws. Both arms use a full weighted paired batch per update and only the fixed endpoint is evaluated.
pair_weighting: Equal mass per initial group and original episode/tick cell within each group. Split each cell equally among its pairs. Deterministic timed and old held-offset captures at a matched history/tick share the cell budget but retain distinct physical snapshots and branch tensors. Each arm sums to one; untreated cells keep their exact weights.

evaluation.reproduction: Require control endpoint model and normalization arrays to match the pinned expanded 900-update reference.
evaluation.legacy_protections: Hold out the same five groups and 36 held-offset pairs and S2 complete routes. Reuse train_s3_history.regression: per-group/amplitude H32 position RMSE <=1.10x, no decrease in strong positive-cosine or cosine>=0.5 counts, and complete-route H8 position RMSE <=1.10x. Report comparisons against the matched control and the historical old_900 reference separately.
evaluation.timed_holdout: Keep validation_lateral tick 168 and every negative_y_basin variant out of training. Score both fixed endpoints and old_900 on the same held H32 nominal and signed branches. Report absolute position, velocity and spin at H8/H16/H24/H32 and fixed H32 JVP/finite-secant position cosine, amplitude ratio and relative vector error using the frozen physics-derived signal floors. Report nominal H32 position error relative to the control. Scope is a data-only coverage intervention in learned models and a single finite-amplitude held snapshot.

stop_conditions: Frozen input, shape, training identity or control reproduction mismatch
Any nonfinite loss, gradient or checkpoint
Resource or time cap, or two fixed 900-update endpoints
No checkpoint selection or automatic rerun
